Activity 1 Read the following dialogues and put the right form (simple present or present perfect) of verbs (in the brackets) in the blanks.

a : Look! I \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (buy) the latest novel of Selina Hossain for you,
I hope you \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (not have) a copy already.
: No, I haven't. Thanks a lot. \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots you \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (read) it?

b : \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots you \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (hear) about Jonathan?
: No, I \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (not see) him recently. What \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (happen)?
: He \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (get) a job in Australia.
: \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots his family \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (know)? \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots he \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (told) his wife?

c : Darling, I \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (get) something important to tell you.
: \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots you \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (hear) anything from Australia?
: Yes, they \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (offer) me the job.
: What \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots you \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (want) to do? What about your job here?
: I \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (decide) to go. I \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (send) my resignation letter this morning, and \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots (put up) an ad in today's newspaper to sell the car too.
